_notes: Storytelling frameworks the script writer can use. Edit freely. 'match_any' lists presentation features (see scouts/viral_analysis.py build_features) that mark a Reel as using the framework; the agent counts how often winners use it versus non-winners. 'beats' must use words from config/viral_vocab.json.

frameworks.name: Myth-bust and reframe
frameworks.hook_formula: Name a belief people hold and say it is wrong, in one short sentence.
frameworks.shape: Common belief -> why it fails -> the reframe -> proof -> what to do instead.

frameworks.name: Numbered list with the best one last
frameworks.hook_formula: Promise a specific number of things and hint that the last one matters most.
frameworks.shape: N short points, each one concrete, the strongest saved for the end.

frameworks.name: Open a question, pay it off late
frameworks.hook_formula: Raise a question or surprise the viewer needs answered, and do not answer it yet.
frameworks.shape: Open loop in the first seconds, a re-hook in the middle, the answer near the end.

frameworks.name: Problem, cost, fix
frameworks.hook_formula: Describe the viewer's problem in their own words.
frameworks.shape: Problem -> what it is costing them -> the fix -> evidence the fix works.

frameworks.name: Before and after
frameworks.hook_formula: Show or state the end result first.
frameworks.shape: Result -> where it started -> the one change -> proof -> how to repeat it.

frameworks.name: Confession, then the lesson
frameworks.hook_formula: Admit a specific mistake or struggle in the first sentence.
frameworks.shape: Honest admission -> what happened -> the turning point -> the lesson.

frameworks.name: Mystery then reveal
frameworks.hook_formula: Present something that looks wrong or impossible.
frameworks.shape: Strange fact -> clues -> the explanation that makes it make sense.
